additionalRules: A Battle of Greenfields Army must always contain Bandobras Took, who is always the Army's General.

specialRules.name: The Bullroarer
specialRules.text: Bandobras Took may declare a Heroic Combat each turn for free.

specialRules.name: "They're dangerous folk, wandering the wilds"
specialRules.text: Rangers of the North increase their Attacks value to 2.

specialRules.name: "Defend the Shire!"
specialRules.text: Friendly Hobbit Warrior models within 3" of Bandobras gain the Dominant (2) special rule.

specialRules.name: The Bounders
specialRules.text: Whilst wholly within their own deployment zone, friendly Hobbit models may re-roll To Hit rolls of a natural 1 when making shooting attacks.

sourceNotes: Roster, points, and army-wide rules from the prancingponypub Legacy Battle Of Greenfields army-list page. Stat blocks and keywords cross-referenced from the Forces of Good faction pages on the same site.
